CURRENT BANKING DIAGNOSIS
Finance and Supabase work. CSP was blocking the app's own API; 7373c68 fixed it.
PLAID_UNAVAILABLE now means Plaid Sandbox rejected credentials/request validation.
The actual PLAID_SECRET was replaced in Vercel Preview. Never share secrets here.
NEXT CHECKPOINT
1. Open the stable preview in a new tab.
2. Dad or Mom → Finance Center → Connect bank · Sandbox.
3. Complete the Sandbox institution flow, then test Sync bank transactions.
4. If it rejects, record only the provider code; never share secrets or tokens.
